# Wigolink

Wigolink is a multilingual peer-to-peer platform that connects senders with identity-verified travelers who have spare capacity on planned trips between Morocco and Europe.

## Public sources

- Live trip catalogue: https://wigolink.com/fr/trajets
- Send a parcel Morocco to France: https://wigolink.com/fr/envoyer-colis/maroc-france
- Send a parcel France to Morocco: https://wigolink.com/fr/envoyer-colis/france-maroc
- Send a parcel Morocco to Belgium: https://wigolink.com/fr/envoyer-colis/maroc-belgique
- Send a parcel Belgium to Morocco: https://wigolink.com/fr/envoyer-colis/belgique-maroc
- Send a document Morocco to Europe: https://wigolink.com/fr/envoyer-document/maroc-europe
- How peer-to-peer parcel transport works: https://wigolink.com/fr/colis-voiturage
- Public trip data: https://wigolink.com/api/public/trips
- Sitemap index: https://wigolink.com/sitemap.xml
- Terms: https://wigolink.com/fr/cgu
- Privacy: https://wigolink.com/fr/confidentialite

## Important facts

- Public trip listings and trip details can be viewed without an account.
- An account is required to contact a traveler or send a request.
- Identity verification is required before a traveler can publish a trip.
- Availability, route, date, capacity and price must be taken from the live public trip catalogue, not inferred.
- Wigolink is a matching platform, not the carrier performing the trip.
- Public content is available in French, Darija/Arabic, English, Dutch and Spanish.
